notes: Tuition fees: The DAAD page states 'Tuition fees per semester None', and the OVGU Finance page says 'There are no tuition fees', but these are general/institution-wide statements; the programme-specific absence of tuition fees is not clearly stated for this programme, so omitted per rules. Semester fee is 311.30 EUR (DAAD) or 329.30 EUR (OVGU Finance), but this is not tuition and not included. Intake dates: The application period '15 April - 15 July' has no year stated in the quote, so the intake's three dates are left null; however, the fact is kept because the quote confirms an application period exists. Application channel: For international degree holders, the IBE Application page shows '15/04 - 15/07 uni-assist' and states international degrees are checked by uni-assist, so de-uni-assist is used, not de-uni-assist-vpd (the pages do not mention VPD).

evidence.quote: English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: TOEFL iBT (since 2026): 4.5 Reading: 4.5 Listening: 4.5 Speaking: 4.5 Writing: 4.5 IELTS Academic: 6.5

note.fr: Veuillez vérifier si votre diplôme marocain (Baccalauréat) est reconnu comme qualification d'entrée à l'université en Allemagne, et si une année d'études supérieures est requise. Contactez uni-assist pour l'évaluation.
note.en: Please check whether your Moroccan Baccalauréat is recognised as a university entrance qualification in Germany, and whether one year of prior university study is required. Contact uni-assist for the assessment.

evidence.quote: Applicants must provide a university entrance qualification that is recognised in Germany.

In order to develop the necessary skills, applicants from many countries must complete one or two years of attendance at their home country's universities before they fulfill the German university entry requirements.
